ocl:
context Procedure
inv: (self.doctor <> null) and (self.record.patient.isInsured = false)

context Admission
inv: (self.patient.isInsured) and (self.admitDate <> '' and self.admitDate.size() > 0)

context InsurancePolicy
inv: ((self.patient.isInsured) and (self.validUntil.size() = 25)) and (self.patient <> null)

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 5 and self.totalAmount <= 78

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 39 and self.totalAmount <= 78

context Payment
inv: self.amount >= 9 and self.amount <= 17

context Hospital
inv: self.departments->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null

context Department
inv: self.doctors->any(x | x.doctorId <> '') <> null

context MedicalRecord
inv: ((self.recordNo <> '') and (self.procedures->forAll(v | v.name <> ''))) and (not((self.recordNo <> '') and (self.procedures->forAll(v | v.name <> ''))))

context Ward
inv: ((self.floor mod 2 = 0) and (self.name.size() = 41)) and (not((self.floor mod 2 = 0) and (self.name.size() = 41)))

context Appointment
inv: ((self.patient.isInsured) and (self.dateTime <> null)) and (not((self.patient.isInsured) and (self.dateTime <> null)))

context Bed
inv: ((self.room <> null) and (self.isOccupied = false)) and (not((self.room <> null) and (self.isOccupied = false)))

context Patient
inv: (self.appointments->forAll(x | x.dateTime <> '')) and (not(self.appointments->forAll(x | x.dateTime <> '')))

context Appointment
inv: ((self.patient.isInsured) and (self.dateTime <> '' and self.dateTime.size() > 0)) and (not((self.patient.isInsured) and (self.dateTime <> '' and self.dateTime.size() > 0)))

context Room
inv: ((self.roomNo <> '') and (self.beds->forAll(v | v.isOccupied <> false))) and (not((self.roomNo <> '') and (self.beds->forAll(v | v.isOccupied <> false))))

context Department
inv: (self.hospital <> null) and (not(self.hospital <> null))

context Person
inv: (self.fullName <> null) and (not(self.fullName <> null))

context Department
inv: (self.doctors->collect(x | x.appointments)->size() >= 2) and (not(self.doctors->collect(x | x.appointments)->size() >= 2))
